rInternal.note: Estimate from Energizer A76 (alkaline LR44). Datasheet Specifications: "Impedance (40 Hz): 3 to 9 ohms"; 6 ohm is the midpoint of that range, (3 + 9) / 2 (the sheet does not say where a fresh cell sits in it).

limits.note: No maximum current is published: the Energizer A76 datasheet characterises only a 7.5 kOhm continuous drain (about 0.17 mA) and says the cell is "designed for electronic applications which may require high rate pulses". 10 mA is an assumed ceiling for a 150 mAh button cell with 3 to 9 ohm impedance, not a sourced figure.

notes: rInternal is a fresh cell at room temperature: it rises as the cell discharges and in the cold.
sourceCurrent is compared as a rating (sim-over-limit warning), not as a hard cut-off.

corrected.why: the datasheet gives only a 3 to 9 ohm range; 6 ohm is a computed midpoint not on the page, so it is an estimate (protocol item 2)
